property_summary: For any ERC20 token asset, calling withdrawFees(asset, recipient) as the owner must set the contract's tracked unclaimedFees[asset] back to zero before any external transfer is attempted, so after any completed withdrawFees the fee ledger for that asset is cleared; the buggy version leaves unclaimedFees[asset] unchanged because it deletes the zeroing statement.
change_summary: Delete the statement that zeroes unclaimedFees[asset], so the fee balance is not cleared.
